definitions: Created (a relationship or new conditions) with effort.
Produced a fraudulent copy or imitation of (a document, signature, banknote, or work of art).
Shaped (a metal object) by heating it in a fire or furnace and beating or hammering it.
examples: He forged her signature on the cheque.
The blacksmith forged the iron into a sword.
The team forged ahead in the second half.
